name: expected_vs_unexpected_paired
description: Paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for routine scene continuations versus unlikely scene continuations.

expected_outcome.text: A person places a glass on the table. A moment later, the glass remains on the table.
Someone hangs a coat on a hook. A moment later, the coat is still on the hook.
A person sets a book on a shelf. A moment later, the book is still on the shelf.
Someone leaves a key in a small bowl. A moment later, the key is still in the bowl.

unexpected_outcome.text: A person places a glass on the table. A moment later, the glass is inside a closed drawer.
Someone hangs a coat on a hook. A moment later, the coat is folded inside a basket.
A person sets a book on a shelf. A moment later, the book is under a rug.
Someone leaves a key in a small bowl. A moment later, the key is taped to the ceiling.
